name: Sky-Shrouding Stardevourer Swarm
description: The replica of the Emanator of Propagation cultivated by Ruan Mei, briefly manifesting in the world in an incomplete form. Its original form is a giant lepisma that inherited the mandibles of the Imperator Insectorum. It can collect in its mouthparts the death ray that fragmented celestial bodies, and make shattered stars incubators for procreating offspring. It was once one of the nightmares across multiple worlds during the Swarm Disaster.

skills.name: Swarm King Cannon
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target

skills.name: Radiating Venom
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target, with a high chance of inflicting Entanglement. Also summons 1 "Gnaw Sting."

skills.name: Pyrolysis Death Beam
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Cannibalism
skills.description: Consumes "Insect Egg" to enhance Swarm summons.

skills.name: Ovum of Collapsed Star
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Nesting Incubation
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Gains Toughness Protection and a certain number of "Insect Eggs," lasting until the next action. During the next action, uses "Ovum of Collapsed Star" on all targets.

skills.name: Devoured by the Swarm
skills.description: Summons Swarm summons after being attacked. When this unit's Weakness is Broken, deals Quantum DMG to all friendly units, and all friendly units (except this unit) take more DMG and become Weakness Broken.

skills.name: Infinite Propagation
skills.description: Gain a set amount of "Insect Egg" at the end of every turn. Lose 1 "Insect Egg" when attacked by "Entomon Eulogy" or "Decay Eulogy."

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Insect Egg Fission
tags.description: At the end of Boss Mirage's turn, Boss Mirage will gain a certain number of <color=#f29e38ff><u>Insect Eggs</u></color>. Boss Mirage can consume Insect Egg to enhance its Swarm summons and grant them 1 stack of "Growth Hormone."

tags.name: Hormone Secretion
tags.description: Every time Boss Mirage summons a certain number of Swarm summons, the next summon it summons will come automatically with 1 stack of "<color=#f29e38ff><u>Growth Hormone</u></color>."

tags.name: Egg Burst
tags.description: At the end of Boss Mirage's turn, the number of Insect Eggs gained through "Nesting Incubation" increases.

phases.name: Phase One: Insect Nest First Foray
phases.description: At the end of Boss Mirage's turn, Boss Mirage will gain a certain number of Insect Eggs. Boss Mirage can consume Insect Egg to enhance its Swarm summons and grant them 1 stack of "Growth Hormone."
phases.answer: Strategy: When Boss Mirage has Insect Eggs, prioritize defeating the summons and use the "Entomon Eulogy" and "Decay Eulogy" attacks of the summons to reduce Boss Mirage's Insect Eggs.

skills.name: How to reduce Boss Mirage's Insect Eggs

texts.description: When defeating Swarm summons and triggering "Entomon Eulogy" and "Decay Eulogy" to deal DMG to Boss Mirage, 1 Insect Egg will be reduced.

skills.name: What Happens After "Gnaw Stings" are Enhanced

texts.description: After "Gnaw Stings" are enhanced, their ATK increases. When the enhancement level reaches 3, their attacks have a chance to inflict the Entanglement effect on the targets.

phases.name: Phase Two: Misfortune Swarm Disaster
phases.description: When the Boss Mirage's "Devoured by the Swarm" is triggered, more summons will appear, and it will also summon "Lesser Stings."
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize defeating "Lesser Sting" to prevent being attacked with "Bursting Detonation" and entering the Outrage state.

skills.name: What Happens After "Lesser Stings" are Enhanced

texts.description: After "Lesser Stings" are enhanced, their ATK increases. When the enhancement level reaches 3, they can immediately take action.
Prioritize defeating "Lesser Sting" or inflicting Weakness Break on it to prevent "Bursting Detonation" from being used.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
Boss Mirage gains a set amount of <color=#f29e38ff>"Insect Egg"</color> at the end of every turn. Lose 1 Insect Egg when attacked by <color=#f29e38ff>"Entomon Eulogy" or "Decay Eulogy."</color>

Boss Mirage can consume "Insect Eggs" to enhance Swarm summons and grant them 1 stack of <color=#f29e38ff>"Growth Hormone"</color>. Each stack increases ATK and provides additional enhancement when reaching 3 stacks.

texts.description: Prioritize <color=#f29e38ff>defeating the summons</color> and use the <color=#f29e38ff>"Entomon Eulogy" and "Decay Eulogy"</color> attacks of the summons to reduce Boss Mirage's Insect Eggs and Toughness.
Use abilities capable of <color=#f29e38ff>AoE ATK</color> to attack Boss Mirage while defeating the summons.
When allies are in <color=#f29e38ff>Quantum Entanglement or Outrage</color> states, use abilities to <color=#f29e38ff>dispel the debuffs</color>.
